name: GJ 687
description: A nearby red dwarf, 42% of the Sun's width: its disc was measured by interferometry.

radius.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 687: radius in solar radii, 0.4183 +/- 0.007, from this work (CHARA)

mass.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 687: mass 0.413 solar masses from the K-band mass-luminosity relation of Henry & McCarthy (1993), not a dynamical mass

temperature.source: Boyajian et al. (2012), ApJ 757, 112, Table 6, GJ 687: effective temperature in K, 3413 +/- 28, from this work (CHARA)

text.card: A nearby red dwarf whose disc was measured by interferometry: 42% of the Sun's width.
text.introduction: Interferometry gives it 0.4183 solar radii; with its total light, that makes its surface 3,413 K.
